integrity_statement: Exact operation counts and graph-orbit counts follow a documented complete case classification, supported by two different standalone reproducibility checkers; no independent scholarly validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: The exact 1021-operation and 194-isomorphism-class census concerns only the eight-element Boolean algebra with three distinguished atoms.
Graph realization holds for powersets of arbitrary sets, but no closed general count for four or more atoms is established.
Search of relevant sources does not prove absolute historical priority; an earlier unindexed classification is possible.
Executable verification is finite corroboration; the general graph construction is justified by a mathematical proof.
title: Graph-negation strata and an exact census of fundamental preconditionals on the eight-element Boolean algebra
